nodes.natural_language:
Determine the smallest non-negative integer $a$ that satisfies the congruences: \begin{align*}
&a\equiv 2\pmod 3,\\
&a\equiv 4\pmod 5,\\
&a\equiv 6\pmod 7,\\
&a\equiv 8\pmod 9.
\end{align*} Show that it is 314.
